title: Synthesis and antimitotic activity of 2-phenyl-6-pyridinyl-2H-pyrazolo[4,3-c]pyridines
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,24822-24837
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09208F, Paper

Vaida Aleksienė, Eva Řezníčková, Aurimas Bieliauskas, Veronika Vojáčková, Veronika Molitorová, Austėja Šalvytė-Nikliauzienė, Sergey Belyakov, Asta Žukauskaitė, Eglė Arbačiauskienė, Vladimír Kryštof, Algirdas Šačkus
A series of new 2-phenyl-6-pyridinyl-2H-pyrazolo[4,3-c]pyridines was prepared. The most active compound 7f disrupts the microtubule cytoskeleton, alters cell morphology, causes mitotic defects, and ultimately leads to cell death.
